title: AI-supported detection of pathological laryngeal diseases based on voice analysis
summary: The aim of this study is to develop and validate a voice analysis using artificial intelligence based on machine learning models for the early detection of laryngeal diseases. Secondarily, the performance of the method in comparison to established clinical diagnostic methods and the diagnostic quality of the underlying algorithm – in particular sensitivity and specificity – will be analyzed.  For the study, generally trained models will be evaluated and adapted specifically with regard to their ability to detect laryngeal diseases by testing newly collected voice signals and examining them in terms of quality, stability, and prognostic significance.
conditions: Diseases of vocal cords and larynx, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name: Voice recordings as part of the diagnosis of patients with laryngeal disease
Voice recordings as part of the diagnosis of patients without laryngeal disease and/or test subjects

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
